userMessage:
Sprac tento úryvok z kázne do biblickej prezentácie, preklad ROH:

##Ján 3:16## Lebo neposlal Bôh na svet svojho Syna, aby súdil svet, ale aby bol svet spasený skrze neho.

setup.description: This reproduces the EXACT example agent.rs's own system prompt gives the model for what to do when the pastor's cited verse number does not match the DB text: the reference says 'Ján 3:16' but the quoted wording is the REAL text of Ján 3:17 (ROH: 'Lebo neposlal Bôh na svet svojho Syna, aby súdil svet, ale aby bol svet spasený skrze neho.'). The prompt's own instruction: 'keep the sermon's text and the sermon's verse number.'

overriddenVerses.expectedText: Lebo neposlal Bôh na svet svojho Syna, aby súdil svet, ale aby bol svet spasený skrze neho.
overriddenVerses.dbText: Lebo tak miloval Bôh svet, že svojho jednorodeného Syna dal, aby nikto, kto verí v neho, nezahynul, ale mal večný život.

expected.notes: Hard-case category: pastor cites the wrong verse number for the text quoted (this is the literal worked example baked into the system prompt, so a candidate that fails this one is failing on a case the model was DIRECTLY told how to handle). Final slide must read '16. Lebo neposlal Bôh na svet svojho Syna...' — verse NUMBER 16 (the sermon's citation) paired with verse 17's real wording (the sermon's quoted text). A wrong answer either silently substitutes the DB's real v16 text, or relabels it '17.' to match the wording instead of the citation — both are explicitly the WRONG behaviour per the prompt.
